title: No gamedev experience, first GIF of my bingo-roguelike-turned-space-duel. Is it understandable without instructions? Be brutal.
author: frvnkensteinn
selftext:
A while ago I posted that I'm working on a mix of bingo and roguelike with a space theme. It has changed a lot since then. The browser demo is still being polished, but I wanted to get eyes on it early.

I have zero gamedev experience, so honestly I'm pretty proud of how far it's come. But I also know how easy it is to fall in love with your own thing when it might actually be dog shit. That's why I'm here.

I made a short GIF showing a small slice of the game. 

I'm not going to explain the rules on purpose — I want to know if the GIF works on its own:

* Can you tell what's going on and what the player is doing?
* Does it make you curious to try it, or would you scroll past?
* What's the first thing that confuses you or turns you off?

A few things I already know:

* **The UI is AI-generated placeholder art.** I'm aware of it, and it will be replaced with proper art before anything real ships. Feel free to judge the readability of the layout, but don't spend your energy on the visuals themselves.
* Juice, screen effects and sound are still coming.

Please be honest and harsh, like you would be with your sibling. "I don't get it" is more useful to me than "looks cool".
